description: React component for a bidder view page in an auction platform, enabling users to join an auction by code, view items, place bids, and receive real-time updates for bids and items.

methods.name: BidderView()
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the bidder interface, managing state, fetching data, and handling real-time bid updates.

methods.name: loadHighBid
methods.description: Async function to fetch and update the highest bid for a specific item.

methods.name: attachBidRealtime
methods.description: Sets up real-time bid subscriptions for a list of items.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads items for a specific event, updates state, and manages real-time bid subscriptions.

methods.name: onChangeName
methods.description: Event handler for updating bidder's name and syncing with local storage.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a temporary success message to the user.

methods.name: handleBid
methods.description: Creates a function to handle placing a bid on an item, including success and error handling, and updating UI.
